g1.label: 1. Good roads, railways and airports make up a country's ______.
g1.why: Infrastructure means roads, railways, airports and other basic systems a country needs.

g2.label: 2. French and English are the two ______ of Canada.
g2.why: Official languages are the languages the law accepts, here French and English in Canada.

g3.label: 3. The ______ crossed the ice for months to reach the North Pole.
g3.why: An explorer travels to learn about new places, such as the North Pole.

g4.label: 4. He plays hockey ______ baseball.
g4.why: 'As well as' means 'and also', so he plays both hockey and baseball.

g5.label: 5. Before giving evidence, the witness had to swear an ______.
g5.why: An oath is a serious promise, such as a witness makes in court.

g6.label: 6. The Arctic winter is ______: it can be minus 40 degrees for weeks.
g6.why: Harsh means cold, rough and unpleasant, like minus 40 degrees for weeks.

g7.label: 7. ______ in Canada have lived there for thousands of years.
g7.why: Indigenous people were the first people to live in a place, for thousands of years.

g8.label: 8. Under colonial rule, many people suffered years of ______.
g8.why: Oppression is cruel treatment that takes away freedom, as under colonial rule.

g9.label: 9. In Québec they speak French, ______ most people in the rest of Canada speak English.
g9.why: 'Whereas' shows a clear difference: French in Québec, English in the rest of Canada.

g10.label: 10. Oil, wood and iron are important ______ in Canada.
g10.why: Natural resources, such as oil, wood and iron, come from nature and are useful.

g11.label: 11. People in Québec speak ______ French, but many also speak English.
g11.why: 'Mainly' means mostly; most people there speak French, but many also speak English.

g12.label: 12. Learning two languages at school can be ______, but it is rewarding.
g12.why: Challenging means difficult but rewarding, like learning two languages at school.

g13.label: 13. Their wedding ______ took place in a small church by the lake.
g13.why: A ceremony is a formal event, such as a wedding in a church.

g14.label: 14. Québec is the biggest ______ in Canada, and most people there speak French.
g14.why: A province is one of the large regions of Canada; Québec is the biggest.

g15.label: 15. He came second in the race, so he got a ______ medal.
g15.why: Silver is the shiny grey-white metal of the second-place medal.

g16.label: 16. A ______ can weigh over 300 kilograms and loves to catch fish and eat berries.
g16.why: A grizzly bear is a large brown North American bear that catches fish and eats berries.

g17.label: 17. We saw a ______ with huge antlers standing in the lake.
g17.why: A moose is a huge animal with wide, flat antlers.

g18.label: 18. After living in Canada for five years, she applied for Canadian ______.
g18.why: Citizenship is the legal right to belong to a country, which she applied for.

g19.label: 19. The country has huge oil ______ under the desert.
g19.why: Reserves are large amounts of oil or gas stored in the ground.

g20.label: 20. Snow and ice have always ______ me. I could watch them for hours.
g20.why: To fascinate is to interest strongly; you could watch something fascinating for hours.

g21.label: 21. Canada ______ wood and oil to many countries.
g21.why: To export is to sell goods, such as wood and oil, to other countries.

g22.label: 22. In winter, we ______ on the frozen lake every weekend.
g22.why: To skate is to move on ice with blades on your shoes, such as on a frozen lake.

g23.label: 23. Cars and bridges are made of steel, which comes from ______.
g23.why: Steel is made from iron, a hard grey metal.
